subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep home-relative display paths by default, switch agent-visible file paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit opt-in full-path mode?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally shorten real home paths, related merged fixes preserved that behavior, and root reply policy discourages both absolute paths and `~/...` in repository review replies, so automation cannot choose the product contract.

options.title: Keep Shorthand Default
options.body: Preserve compact `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` display for valid home paths while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

options.title: Switch To Absolute Defaults
options.body: Change user-facing agent/tool path output to full absolute paths by default and update prompts, docs, and tests consistently.

options.title: Add Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep current defaults but add a documented opt-in setting for users who need absolute path output.

recommendation.title: Keep Shorthand Default
recommendation.body: Preserve compact `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` display for valid home paths while continuing to fix only corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a cross-surface display contract, and recent shared path utility plus repository policy history point here as the best available routing candidate.
